name: Rankfixer SEO Ranker
author: seorankfixer

sections.description:
Rankfixer SEO Ranker is the official WordPress plugin for SEO Rank Fixer (https://seorankfixer.com).

SEO Rank Fixer finds the changes that win more clicks on Google and Bing and writes them for you: new titles, meta descriptions, structured data (JSON-LD), FAQ blocks and image alt text. This plugin lets you put a written fix live with one click from SEO Rank Fixer.

  • Changes are made on the server, in the page HTML, so Google, Bing and AI assistants see them.
  • WooCommerce stores: fix products from SEO Rank Fixer’s Products page. Change a product’s SEO title, meta description and image alt text, and add its brand, GTIN (barcode number) and MPN plus your store’s shipping and return policy to the product structured data WooCommerce already prints, so Google and Bing can show price, stock, shipping and returns. Only facts you enter are added; ratings and reviews are never added (WooCommerce prints them from your real reviews).
  • With Yoast SEO, Rank Math or SEOPress active, titles and descriptions go into their fields, so a page never has two.
  • Every change keeps the value it replaced and can be undone from SEO Rank Fixer or from Settings, SEO Rank Fixer.
  • Publish an article written by SEO Rank Fixer’s AI writer as a post, as a draft or live. Undo moves it to the trash (only posts the plugin created).
  • Nothing changes unless you press Apply or Publish in SEO Rank Fixer. The plugin never runs code sent to it: it only saves text fields and article HTML after cleaning them (article HTML with wp_kses_post, the same rules as a post written in WordPress).

Requests from SEO Rank Fixer are signed with your site’s connection key (HMAC-SHA256 with a timestamp and a one-time nonce). Old or repeated requests are refused.

External services

This plugin works with SEO Rank Fixer (https://seorankfixer.com), an SEO service run by SEO Rank Fixer. It is needed to apply the fixes the service writes and to publish its articles.

The plugin does not call out by itself. SEO Rank Fixer sends signed requests to this site’s REST API (under /wp-json/seo-rank-fixer/) only when you connect the site, press Check connection, press Apply or Undo on a fix, or press Publish or Undo on an article in your SEO Rank Fixer account. Each fix request sends the page address and the text of the change (title, meta description, structured data, FAQ or image alt text); the plugin answers with the page’s current values and its own version so the service can show and undo changes. With WooCommerce active, SEO Rank Fixer can also ask for your published products when you open its Products page: the plugin answers with each product’s name, address, SEO title, meta description, short description, price, stock, SKU, GTIN, brand, review count and image addresses with their alt text, so the service can show what to fix. A product fix sends the product’s ID and the new SEO title, meta description, image alt text, brand, GTIN or MPN; a store fix sends your shipping cost, delivery days and return policy. Each publish request sends the article (its title, HTML body, excerpt, URL slug, SEO title and meta description) and whether to save it as a draft or publish it; the plugin answers with the new post’s id, address and status so the service can link to it and move it to the trash on Undo. No visitor data is sent or collected.

  • Terms of Service: https://seorankfixer.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://seorankfixer.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. In SEO Rank Fixer, open your site, then Settings, Connect WordPress, and download the plugin.
  2. In WordPress, go to Plugins, Add New, Upload Plugin, choose the zip file, then Install and Activate.
  3. Copy the connection key from SEO Rank Fixer into Settings, SEO Rank Fixer, save, then press Check connection in SEO Rank Fixer.
sections.faq:
What does the plugin change?

Only the page you apply a fix to, and only its SEO title, meta description, structured data, FAQ block under the content and image alt text. Articles you publish from SEO Rank Fixer become new posts; existing posts are never changed by publishing.

Can I publish an article?

Yes. On an article in SEO Rank Fixer, press Save as draft in WordPress or Publish now. The post gets the article’s title, text, excerpt and URL slug, and its SEO title and meta description go into your SEO plugin’s fields. Images are not added: add them in WordPress. Undo moves the post to the trash.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. When WooCommerce is active, SEO Rank Fixer’s Products page lists your products and what each one is missing for Google and Bing. Write a new SEO title and meta description (or let SEO Rank Fixer’s AI write them), add image alt text, brand, GTIN and MPN, and apply them in one click. Titles and descriptions go into Yoast SEO, Rank Math or SEOPress when one is active; alt text goes into the Media Library. Every change can be undone.

Will it add star ratings to my products?

No. Ratings and reviews come only from your real WooCommerce reviews, which WooCommerce prints itself. The plugin only adds facts you enter: brand, GTIN, MPN, shipping and returns.

Can I undo a change?

Yes. Press Undo on the fix in SEO Rank Fixer, or in Settings, SEO Rank Fixer, Recent changes.

My page still shows the old title

A page cache may still hold the old page. The plugin clears the cache of WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, W3 Total Cache and WP Super Cache. With another cache or a CDN, clear it once.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • New: WooCommerce product fixes. With WooCommerce active, SEO Rank Fixer lists your products and applies product SEO titles, meta descriptions and image alt text in one click, into Yoast SEO, Rank Math or SEOPress when one is active.
  • New: add a product’s brand, GTIN and MPN, and your store’s shipping and return policy, to WooCommerce’s own Product structured data, so Google and Bing can show them. Only facts you enter are added; ratings are never added.
  • Every product change keeps the value it replaced and can be undone from SEO Rank Fixer or from Settings, SEO Rank Fixer.

1.2.1

  • The plugin is now called Rankfixer SEO Ranker (permalink rankfixer-seo-ranker).
  • Each signed request can be used only once, even when two copies arrive at the same moment: the nonce is claimed with a single database insert.

1.2.0

  • Internal names now use the seorafi_ prefix. Your connection key, change history and applied changes carry over automatically.

1.1.0

  • New: publish an article written by SEO Rank Fixer as a post (draft or live), with its SEO title and meta description in your SEO plugin’s fields. Undo moves it to the trash; only posts the plugin created can be trashed.

1.0.0

  • First release.
